title: fix(app-showcase): label the invoice pre-tax roll-up Subtotal / 小计, not Total / 合计
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XS45uS4YmpkyKDUwCT41Tq)_

Fixes #36314
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：示例应用里发票的记录页和编辑表单上，税前金额的标签从「Total / 合计」改为「Subtotal / 小计」，不再和旁边的「Total incl. Tax / 含税总额」看着像两个总额。
- 为什么做：发票页面体验问题——替看发票的人分清哪个是税前、哪个是含税。
- 出错会怎样：只动示例应用里一个字段的显示文字，最坏是标签措辞不合适，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`: `showcase_invoice.fields.total.label` reads `Subtotal` (en, was `Total`) and `小计` (zh-CN, was `合计`). The object metadata already labels the field `Subtotal` (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts`), and the line-grid summary stack calls the same figure Subtotal; only the bundle disagreed.
- The bundle ships exactly two locales, `en` and `zh-CN` — no other locale key exists anywhere under `examples/app-showcase` (grep for `ja-JP` / `es-ES`: zero hits), so "every shipped language" is these two.
- The comment above `showcase_expense_report` that said 「合计 is showcase_invoice's `total`」 moves with the label: 合计 is now the report's own total, and the invoice's pre-tax `total` reads 小计 beside its 含税总额.
- Not changed: the field name, any other field's label, the expense report's own 合计 (`total_amount`), the source metadata.
- No test, QA checklist item or fixture pinned the old label: a grep over `examples/`, `packages/qa/`, `docs/qa/` and every `*.test.ts` for the old invoice label finds nothing to update (the `records-forms` checklist item already calls this field "the Subtotal (`total`)").

**Read first** (risk order): the two label lines in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` (en block, zh-CN block); the rewritten comment above `showcase_expense_report` in the same file.

**Two-minute check:** boot the showcase, open invoice INV-1010 — the record page and the edit form read `Subtotal €230.00` beside `Total incl. Tax €276.00`; switch to zh-CN and they read 小计 beside 含税总额.

## Tests

Text-only change in a private example; no behaviour moved, so no new pin and no ablation. Run on the final head `60d6b511` (after merging `origin/main`):

<details><summary>showcase typecheck + tests (under the shared verify lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck` — clean (tsc --noEmit, no output).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` — `Test Files 49 passed (49)`, `Tests 554 passed (554)`.
- Lock verdict: `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0` (closure build + typecheck + test in one locked run).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No changeset, `skip-changeset`: the only path touched is `examples/app-showcase` (`@objectstack/example-showcase`, a private package) — nothing any released package ships moves.
- Screenshot of INV-1010: NOT MEASURED. `pnpm dev` refuses to boot in this worktree until the whole workspace is built (its prerequisite check names 35 of 108 packages without a `dist/`, most under `ui/`); a full workspace build for a screenshot was outside this card's budget, and no full dogfood run was made for it.
